uca_sentences: A man wearing a black hat and blue clothes stood in front of the counter, and a clerk wearing a white apron and black hat stood behind the counter at the cashier.
The clerk wearing a white apron and a black hat clicks on the checkout display to talk to a man wearing a black hat and blue clothes.
The man wearing a black hat and blue clothes took out a pistol and communicated with the store clerk.
The man pointed a gun at the clerk, and the clerk opened the cashier drawer to withdraw money.
The clerk handed the money to the man and the drawer to the man. The man didn't want it, and the clerk put the drawer back.

witness_A.viewpoint: close by, inside, a few metres away
witness_A.statement: I saw a man in blue clothes rob the place. He was wearing a black hat and had a pistol. The person being robbed, also wearing a black hat, handed him the money. I'm not sure if the person clicked on the checkout display or talked to the robber.

witness_B.viewpoint: far away, looking in from outside
witness_B.statement: I saw a man in blue clothes who robbed the place. The cashier, wearing a black apron, was being robbed. The cashier clicked on the checkout display, put the drawer back, and talked to the robber before opening the cashier drawer. I think the robber was holding a pistol.

witness_C.statement: I saw a man in blue clothes who robbed the place. The person being robbed, who works there, opened the cashier drawer and handed the money to the man. I think a pistol was held by the man in blue clothes. I'm pretty sure the vehicle was a white van.
